English: Steam Pit
A primitive earthwork pit lined with stones, heated by fire and filled with water to create soothing steam for weary nomads.
Hot Stone Hut
A small, makeshift hut built from mud, reeds, and hides, featuring a stone hearth for heating water and creating therapeutic steam.
Heated Pavilion
A spacious tented structure with heated stones and benches, serving as a communal gathering and cleansing area.
Bath Chamber
A semi-permanent bath chamber, constructed from timber and daub, with sectioned pools and heated stones for greater comfort and hygiene.
Changing Room
A private annex for changing and storing belongings, indicating growing sophistication in nomadic bath culture.
Warm Hall
A timbered and insulated hall for communal relaxation after bathing, fostering clan unity and health.
Scented Room
An aromatic retreat with herbal infusions and scented steam, improving the morale and well-being of all who partake.
Family Bathhouse
A prestigious, clan-based bathhouse with separate pools for families, encouraging both health and fertility among the tribe.
Community Bath Hall
A grand hall with heated floors and advanced waterworks, open to all clansfolk, providing unmatched hygiene and unity.
Dravidian Grand Bathhouse

A monumental, stone-clad bathhouse inspired by the Dravidian tradition, complete with marble pools, aromatic chambers, and a meeting hall for tribal councils. A symbol of civilization and unity for all nomads in the realm.
